tasks.do: Ticks match order rows one to one: no tick lost for a bulb, translate or shown hint (those count only on the hints badge) or a stray with no row; a wrong item marks that person's row (per person, not deduplicated); a wrong count shows as wrong. The word review always puts wrong on the left and right on the right, even with one column (SH-49, SH-50, SH-03, CK-07).
tasks.accept: pantry and 2-person chai end screens after a bulb press and one wrong item: ticks = rows, the wrong word red on the left; screenshot of a one-column all-right and all-wrong review

tasks.do: A wrong item is redone on the spot through one shared API the stations call: the rest stays done, that item empties, its row reopens, the second try has help (glow), after three wrong tries the game shows the right way (decision 51, CK-23). Wire it into chai and one clinic game as the reference; B and C wire the rest.
tasks.accept: chai 2-person with one wrong cup: only that cup redoes; third wrong try shows the answer

tasks.do: The next step is always visible: at L2+ once a counted step reaches its count, the next step's row appears and its tool glows after ~2 s; where the outcome is obvious the round moves on by itself with no Found it / ✓ / stage button (decision 52, CLN-82, CLN-83). Fix in the shared card and heal host so every game gets it.
tasks.accept: scrape, knee, boing, foot at L2: after the count the next row and glow appear; no stuck state

tasks.do: Requests first: one pop-up shows everyone who orders (Cook) or the doctor's request (pharmacy, heal games), each said in the speaker's own bubble, tap to skip; then the cards fold to the sidebar and the game is quiet (decision 53, CHAI-15, CLN-84, T6, T27).
tasks.accept: 3-person chai: all three come in and the pop-up shows three cards before play

tasks.do: The guide box follows rules R1-R4: one line per step in step with the highlight; never the whole card; L1 speaks as each step opens, L2+ only after a pause with the glow (first item too); a spoken line clears when its step ends; bubbles from faces for on-screen speakers, the box for off-screen guides; one card with a top strip when the asker is the guide (pantry, daar chop). Provide the shared API; B and C fill the per-station lines (SH-56, SH-60, SH-63, PAN-10).
tasks.accept: pantry L1 and L2 and one heal game behave as T1, T2 and T29; no face appears twice

tasks.do: The bulb also flips the guide line to English and always shows the full order with numbers; a number is written the first times it is heard at any level; on spoken cards the closed card's eye is a small bulb with no counter (decision 57, SH-52, SH-57, CLN-91).
tasks.accept: maani L3 bulb shows 'two chapati'; pantry bulb translates the guide line; waiting-room L3 shows a small bulb

tasks.do: One highlight at a time, one colour token, gold outlines drawn inside (never clipped by overflow), a flat ✓ with no shadow that glows when it is the only thing left; the serve stamp is a picture per card; written English verdict floats (Perfect!, Burnt!, Golden!, Boiled over!, Too early…) become pictures (R5, SH-53, SH-55, SH-58, SH-61, SH-54, T20).
tasks.accept: x2 zoom screenshots of a highlighted row, the ✓ and a verdict moment show no clipping, no shadow, no English

tasks.do: Speech: a tap pauses the line, the count word plays, the line carries on; trim the gap between count words (PAN-11, PAN-12). The closing line is a chef's call-back of what was made, then Shabash and a happy face (decision 54, CK-22). Remove arre re; use Mum's 'oh oh oh' clip if it exists (search data/family-audio.json), else a soft sound, at L1 only on a real mistake (R6, CHT-09).
tasks.accept: tap mid-line in the pantry: she resumes; serve says the call-back; no 'arre re' anywhere (grep)

tasks.do: The button family: one consistent set of buttons and icons on the screens in use (sidebar tabs, end screen, day summary, clinic stage buttons), from js/shared only (non-negotiable 8). The '?' gets a grown-up 'play as new' and Cook's 'Start over' also clears learned words (SH-60). Clear the '?' pulse at each new order (SH-59).
tasks.accept: side-by-side screenshot of every button kind; fresh profile after 'play as new' shows every word

tasks.do: Loading: measure Cook and clinic lab page load, then load per station or game only (no serial JSON chain, games loaded on demand) (CK-25, CLN-88). Rebuild the placeholder robot voice at full speed (decision 63, LNG-09).
